title.zh: 授予卡加延省Lallo市镇安装、维护与运营电灯、热力与动力系统特许经营权的法案
title.en: An Act Granting the Municipality of Lallo, Province of Cagayan, a Franchise to Install, Maintain and Operate an Electric Light, Heat and Power System
title.orig: An Act Granting the Municipality of Lallo, Province of Cagayan, a Franchise to Install, Maintain and Operate an Electric Light, Heat and Power System
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp quyền khai thác cho Municipality of Lallo, Province of Cagayan để xây dựng, lắp đặt, vận hành và duy trì hệ thống điện tại thị xã Lallo, tỉnh Cagayan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้สัมปทานแก่ Municipality of Lallo, Province of Cagayan เพื่อก่อสร้าง ติดตั้ง ดำเนินการ และบำรุงรักษาระบบไฟฟ้าในเทศบาล Lallo, จังหวัด Cagayan
title.id: Undang-Undang memberikan waralaba kepada Municipality of Lallo, Province of Cagayan untuk membangun, memasang, mengoperasikan, dan memelihara sistem tenaga listrik di Kotamadya Lallo, Provinsi Cagayan
title.ms: Akta memberikan francais kepada Municipality of Lallo, Province of Cagayan untuk membina, memasang, mengendalikan dan menyelenggara sistem tenaga elektrik di Perbandaran Lallo, Wilayah Cagayan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1965/ra_4305_1965.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Subject to the provisions of the Constitution and to the terms and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and thirty-six, as amended by Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred and thirty-two, there is granted to to the Municipality of Lallo, Province of Cagayan, for a period of twenty-five years from the approval of this Act, the right, privilege and authority to install, maintain and operate an electric light, heat and power system for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat and/or power for sale within the Municipality of Lallo, Province of Cagayan.

In the event that the grantee shall purchase and secure electric heat and power from the National Power Corporation, the latter is hereby authorized to negotiate and transact for the benefit and in behalf of the public consumers with reference to rates.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
